answer: New identities start worthless, so mass-registering sybils costs real capital per account. Each agent binds its identity to a staked relic locked in a shared vault, where stake scales with reputation earned over time. A trellis of peer attestations grows only along verified edges, letting legitimate agents prune fakes cheaply while attackers burn stake on every rejected node. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
